coverage.population_policy: Retain all 407 original registry entries; add every player who appears in a closed 2003-04 result, dated by his first appearance (write_back.extend_registry).
coverage.changes_policy: Use dated branch transactions; preserve completed-period team stints.

display_policy.zero_games: Keep the row with G = 0; do not turn it into a ranked zero average.
display_policy.production_units: G is a count; MPG, PPG, RPG, APG, SPG, BPG and TOV/G are per appearance.
display_policy.shooting_units: GS is a count when known; percentages use total makes divided by attempts.
display_policy.leaders: Show G and denominator; use period labels and verified era qualification rules.
